g.text: Universal Evidence-First Engineering Protocol & Execution Lifecycle
Automatic upgrade from v1 layout to v2
Safe TOCTOU recovery without data loss
Phase tracked · Verification cycle counter · Zero secret leakage
Captures observed commands & structured evidence items
Are all contract requirements covered by valid evidence in cycle N?
Rejects premature claims, future-lifecycle leakage, and mixed criteria
Exact requirementId matching for PUBLICATION & PRODUCTION
forgeloop complete → VALID (Terminal) or REJECTED (Cycle N+1)
Evidence-only rejection appends COMPLETION_REJECTED event and resets to VERIFYING
Deterministic cross-artifact hashing prevents silent drift and stale state execution
Revalidation Trigger: Changed Contract · Changed Git HEAD · Missing Required Artifacts → REVALIDATION_REQUIRED
ForgeLoop is a protocol, not an agent runtime
Structured multi-agent delegation bundles with explicit scope, required artifacts & contract assumptions
Universal Integration: Codex · Claude Code · Cursor · Copilot · Antigravity · OpenCode · Hermes · Pi · Custom AI Agents & Devs
